summary: Section 319 CrPC invocation based on eyewitness testimony; trial court's summons of additional accused upheld; High Court interference improper at pre-trial stage; reappreciation of evidence impermissible in revision; Section 149 IPC applicability without overt act; presence in unlawful assembly sufficient; Hardeep Singh precedent affirmed; impugned order set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order quashed; trial court's summoning of accused under Section 319 CrPC restored.
